title: Google sign-in
startFailed: Unable to open Google sign-in. Please try again.
notLinked: This Google account can't sign in here yet. Its address must match your login's verified email: sign in once with an email link, then try Google again.
noAccount: No login at this gym uses that Google address. Ask your gym to invite you, or sign in another way.
failed: That sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
on: Staff and members can sign in with a Google account. It signs in an existing login only: the Google address must match the login's email, and both must be verified. Nobody gets a new login through Google.
off: Google sign-in is off. To let staff and members sign in with a Google account, enter your gym's Google OAuth client below. It signs in existing logins only: nobody gets a new login through Google.
source: This install's operator set up the Google OAuth client in the server's configuration. To turn Google sign-in off, remove it there.
sourceGym: Your gym's own Google OAuth client signs people in.
unreadable: can't be read; enter the client again
redirect: Authorized redirect URI for this gym
redirectHelp: The OAuth client in Google Cloud must list this address exactly.
setupHelp: In Google Cloud, create an OAuth client of type "Web application", add the redirect URI above to it, then enter its client ID and secret here.
secretHint: The secret is never shown again. To change either value, enter both.
saved: Saved. The next Google sign-in uses this client.
onlySignIn: Google is your only way to sign in. Set up email or a password before turning it off.
installConfigured: This install's configuration sets Google sign-in, so it can't be changed here.
notConfigured: Your gym has no Google client of its own.
conflict: These settings changed in another window. They have been reloaded; try again.
error: That didn't work. Please try again.
loadError: Google sign-in settings could not be loaded.
